title: Mutually inverse fs logarithmic morphisms
statement: Let $X,Y$ be locally Noetherian fs log schemes and $f:Y\to X$, $g:X\to Y$ log morphisms as in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. They are mutually inverse if both composites equal the identity log morphisms. Explicitly, there is a log endomorphism $h_Y:Y\to Y$ with $h_Y=g\circ f$ on the underlying schemes and all relative etale log sections, and $h_Y$ is the identity in the sense of [def-per-strict-log-morphism]; likewise there is $h_X:X\to X$ with $h_X=f\circ g$ and $h_X$ the identity. Thus this tests inverse equations for full log morphisms, not only for scheme maps.
